texts: tesla super charger handshake issue over holidays while attempting to road trip my ioniq 5 consistently failed within 2 to 5 minutes when plugged into tesla superchargers magic dock despite the cars charge limits being set to 100 the sessions would abruptly terminate and the carapp would display a misleading charging completed due to settings message furthermore the tesla charging location with over 100 stalls did not appear on the tesla app as a viable station eventhough 10s of people were successfully chsrging at the time we moved to a smaller location called hyundai support and were walked through a hard reset of bluelink which enabled us to charge enough to get out of the remote town upon arrival at our destination and trying another tesla location it was rejected again and then briefly showed in the tesla charger app as temporarily out of service but teslas were successfully charging at that time however when moved to a 350kw electrify america station the car performed perfectly and charged successfully at high speeds my initial assumption after ai diagnosis the car was suffering from a hardware failure specifically the dreaded iccu integrated charging control unit issue or a faulty charging port because the car kept reporting that a limit had been reached it appeared that the vehicles software was glitching and incorrectly forcing the session to stop upon successfully charging at a high speed ea location we determined the car is actually healthy the failure was a handshakevoltage conflict tesla superchargers are 400v systems to charge the ioniq 5s 800v battery the car has to use its own motorinverter to boost the voltage this creates electrical noise that the tesla station often misinterprets as a fault killing the session ea 350kw stations are native 800v so no boost is needed allowing the car to charge without the communication errors the limit reached message is simply a generic default the hyundai software shows when a station kicks it off unexpectedly i plan on bringing it in for a check up after the holidays just in case but charging successfully everywhere except tesla who could blame my beautiful hyundai for not liking tesla and on my home charger as well anyone else have inconsistencies when attempting to use tesla super chargers this holiday season or before

mercedes ant infestation how to deal with im having a weird ant infestation on my mercedes cclass i have no idea where they are coming from but im assuming they are in the hvac system i ran my vehicle in high heat and that triggered them to come out ive always seen ants in my car here and there around my dashboard but i thought it was just from outside because it was just a couple but now theyve multiplied does anybody know how to deal with this any recommendations or products do i need to get a pest control technician and euro mechanic to work together ive actually been having some weird electrical can bus faults on my car as well and now im thinking this could very possibly been the ants chewing the harness which i wouldnt think is a common thing but probably possible i was having instrument cluster air bag module and display unit fault codes im just very confused how these ants reproduced in my car i keep up to all the maintenance on my car and i detail it every now and then the car is definitely clean and not dirty its also a newer vehicle its a 2020 i also do luxury transportation and i have yet a customer to complain about ants so it has not reached the passenger seating yet the ants usually come out from the vents mirrors and trim pieces on my dashboard they are inside the engine bay too and they like to swarm around my right mirror outside and the trim pieces attached to it im definitely going to deal with this now since ive confirmed the infestation im also not exactly sure what type of ants they are they definitely arent the normal kind they are really fast thats something ive noticed and they are bigger than the normal ant i think they might be fire ants

maine closes state offices for storm travel hazards warned maine gov janet mills ordered all state of maine government offices closed statewide on wednesday december 24 2025 citing forecast winter weather expected to create hazardous travel conditions the move is aimed at reducing unnecessary commuting during a hightravel holiday window while state and local emergency partners coordinate storm response and public safety messaging what happened in a state announcement dated december 23 2025 the governors office said an overnight storm system was expected to bring dangerous road conditions into christmas eve the national weather service forecast widespread snowfall across much of maine and warned that some areas could see extremely dangerous travel conditions the advisory window covered impacts beginning tuesday afternoon continuing overnight and extending into wednesday morningtiming that directly overlaps common holiday travel and lastminute errands why it matters now closing state offices reduces traffic volume during plowing operations and limits exposure for state employees who would otherwise be on the roads it also signals to private employers and local governments that conditions may warrant flexible schedules or delayed openings for residents the immediate impact is operational fewer inperson state services for one day with the tradeoff being fewer vehicles on highways and local roads during the most hazardous period how maine coordinates a response the state said the maine emergency management agency mema is coordinating with the maine department of transportation maines electric utilities and local emergency management partners that coordination typically focuses on road treatment and plowing priorities outage readiness and situational awareness if conditions deteriorate while the announcement did not quantify expected totals statewide it emphasized that the forecast was broad enough to warrant a statewide closure rather than a regional approach what happens next the practical next steps are weatherdependent if the storm tracks colder or heavier than expected travel advisories may extend and restoration work could shift toward outages and downed trees if the storm underperforms the closure still functions as a precaution during one of the busiest travel periods of the year either way maines approach illustrates a recurring winter tradeoff shortterm service disruption versus reducing preventable crashes and delays during peak hazard windows do statewide closures help safety or should decisions be left townbytown

energy news breakthrough in sodiumion batteries a giant leap for sustainability in the ongoing quest for sustainable energy solutions the demand for battery technologies that stray from the scarce and environmentally harmful elements like lithium has never been higher recent groundbreaking research from the university of surrey unveils a promising future for sodiumion batteries offering potential avenues for cleaner energy and environmental conservation advancements in sodiumion battery technology the role of water in enhancing battery performance the university of surreys research has pivoted the conventional understanding of battery technology on its head by showcasing a novel approach to sodiumion batteries by retaining water in nanostructured sodium vanadate hydrate nvoh cathodes the researchers have remarkably discovered that the battery performance doubles in charge capacity offers ultrafast charging and remains stable for over 400 cycles this wet material paradigm outperforms its dry counterparts and stands toetotoe with the leading cathode materials currently in use the study published on physorg elucidates how this breakthrough could be instrumental not just for battery technology but also for much broader applications the ability of such materials to function effectively in not only conventional environments but also harsh saltwater conditions paves the way for innovative electrochemical desalination of seawater the implications of sodiumion advancements reducing reliance on scarce resources one of the primary significances of this breakthrough lies in its potential to move the industry away from lithium dependency lithium although crucial in current battery technology poses significant environmental and economic challenges due to its scarcity and the destructive mining processes involved sodium on the other hand is both abundant and less harmful environmentally rendering it a more sustainable choice the implications for greener grid storage systems and electric vehicles evs are profound promising not only to mitigate environmental damage but also to potentially reduce costs associated with energy storage technologies energy storage meets seawater desalination another compelling advantage demonstrated by sodiumion technology is its ability to desalinate saltwater as the nvoh cathode extracts sodium ions a graphite anode simultaneously removes chloride ions making the process dualpurpose storing energy and purifying water this dual capability could address two significant global challengesenergy storage and clean water accessibilitywithin a single technological framework the bigger picture the findings by dr daniel commandeur and his team suggest a seismic shift not only within the field of battery technology but also in broader environmental strategies as commandeur stated the results were completely unexpected challenging preexisting norms about the necessity of water expulsion from battery cathodes paving the way for commercial adoption for the commercial sphere these advancements propel sodiumion batteries to the forefront of research and development offering a viable and competitive alternative to current lithiumion technologies the promise of reduced costs and a smaller carbon footprint positions this innovation as a frontrunner in sustainable energy solutions social media reaction and public engagement the news of this breakthrough has been met with eager anticipation across various social media platforms on twitterx users are buzzing with excitement about the possibilities this new development opens up for sustainable tech linkedin professionals are engaging in discussions about the impact on industries ranging from renewable energies to water management systems meanwhile greener than lithium desalts seawater sustainable energy future yes batterytech cleanenergy sodiumion 2 linkedin professional sustainability win surrey scientists boost sodiumion batteries by not removing water from cathodesdoubling capacity ultrafast charging and stable for 400 cycles bonus desalts saltwater abundant sodium means cheaper greener evs grids vs lithium mining woes gamechanger 2021 sorento sx how do people actually get media or consumer advocacy help for ongoing car issues hi everyone im pretty exhausted and hoping for direction i own a 2021 kia sorento sx that has been in and out of service repeatedly since late october 2025 and im stuck in a loop where serious issues continue but are repeatedly labeled as unable to be replicated im not looking to jump straight into legal action im trying to understand how people get media or consumer advocacy attention and whether that helps or hurts at this stage below is a condensed timeline to give context without overwhelming anyone condensed timeline 2021 kia sorento sx background pattern vehicle purchased 6152021 first major failure occurred at 6099 miles stall tow since then the vehicle has experienced recurrent dash errors loss of power stalling and hvac failures these issues have occurred across 12 documented service or diagnostic visits in multiple states many issues are motiondependent and do not present while idling 10242025 vehicle dropped off at kia dealership per kia escalations 10262025 major diagnostic findings ac hvac firestone confirmed premature evaporator core failure well below typical 150k200k mile lifespan kia diagnostics confirmed evaporator core failure and compressor involvement hvac unable to maintain consistent heating or cooling intermittent noises and airflow issues demonstrated to advisor sunroof moonroof active water intrusion into cabin during rainfall photos provided sunroof resists hesitates and struggles to close properly electrical power issues ongoing engine stuttering hesitation jerking and intermittent loss of power nearstalling behavior consistent with prior electricalpower concerns this pattern has existed since 6099 miles 1212025 pickup after ac repair vehicle picked up after ac repair was completed horn was nonfunctional upon pickup a broken piece of an unidentified interior component was found inside the vehicle postrepair dealer advised ac dust cloth was missing and ordered a replacement intermittent heating issues noted including whistling at certain temperature and fanspeed settings between pickup and return vehicle experienced engine stalling loss of power approximately 35 times during normal driving 1222025 heating issue observed heat blows normally after startup after 12 hours of driving air turns cool even with temp set to max 7880f switching between heat and ac weakens airflow after vehicle is turned off for 3040 minutes heat returns with continued driving heat fades back to cool again seat warmers are the only consistently functioning heat source 1242025 vehicle returned to dealership vehicle returned to address nonfunctional horn ongoing hvac temperature inconsistency incorrect airflow routing continued stalling concerns demonstrated ventbyvent temperature testing showing inconsistent temps and airflow not matching selected vent locations dealer stated vehicle had been testdriven but could not replicate issues based on kia access data the observed vehicle movement did not reflect the type of extended realworld driving required to reproduce motiondependent failures these issues do not present at idle meaning stationary diagnostics would not capture them advisor stated they wished videos had been received earlier despite prior submission of a binder with 65 pages of service records a flash drive with video evidence what im hoping to understand how people successfully get media or consumer advocacy attention local news investigative reporters consumer help segments whether going public tends to help or hurt what typically makes a car case worth covering whether other 2021 kia owners sorento or similar models have experienced recurring electrical stalling or hvac issues that dealers say they cant reproduce i also have a full chronological log of dash errors engine events and 12 service visits dating back to 6099 miles with photos and videos available if helpful i am lost and need assistance i also want to make other drivers aware if they have the same year as mine any insight or shared experience would be appreciated thank you

desperate ground sun tzu described this as desperate ground also called death ground short for deathorglory reed hastings and marc randolph faced it during netflixs shift from dvds to streaming years of investment in disc logistics left no neutral option delay would allow apple and amazon to dominate digital distribution committing to licensing streaming rights created desperate ground reversing course would waste resources and leave the company without a future they advanced swiftly building infrastructure before competitors could respond jan koum and brian acton confronted the same pressure while scaling whatsapp users multiplied rapidly server costs soared yet they refused advertising to protect privacy investors warned that subscriptions would fail abandoning principles threatened the user base committing to minimal fees and disciplined engineering removed retreat forcing decisive action that preserved both growth and product identity spotify founders daniel ek and martin lorentzon faced death ground negotiating recordlabel agreements each label could block the service delay increased exposure and risk they invested limited capital to secure agreements converting commitment into leverage and establishing a foothold that competitors could not challenge immediately teslas early entry into electric vehicles illustrates the principle outside software by launching a luxury roadster in 2008 elon musk avoided direct competition in segments dominated by established automakers sedans and suvs remained defended and every competitor prepared for volume markets rather than niche performance vehicles tesla created desperate ground for itself by committing to costly battery development and manufacturing processes leaving retreat impossible and forward action mandatory instagram applied the same strategy in 2010 facebook optimized for desktop and dismissed mobileonly tools as too narrow instagram focused on mobile photography alone a market deemed trivial when mobile usage surged the companys prior commitment transformed into a dominant position forcing facebook to respond from an unprepared stance across industries desperate ground forces decisive movement it converts risk into leverage compels commitment and rewards calculated action under pressure only those willing to advance without a path for retreat can transform exposure into opportunity forcing competitors investors and customers to react to decisions made at speed when the exit closes the only option is to fight adapt and prevail or accept irreversible failure leadership on death ground demands clarity courage and unyielding commitment when no retreat exists hesitation becomes fatal leaders must assess resources focus effort and inspire action despite fear by embracing the stakes they transform pressure into momentum compel teams to perform beyond perceived limits and turn situations of extreme vulnerability into opportunities for decisive transformative success takeaway forced action amplifies leverage by creating desperate ground for themselves founders compel competitors investors and markets to respond on their terms

need some advice im posting this mainly to document my experience and to see if anyone else has dealt with something similar because at this point im honestly exhausted and discouraged i originally brought my hyundai into the dealership for a crankshaft sensor issue after about a week i got the car back and was charged for the crankshaft sensor replacement i trusted the repair and drove the car normally within three days the same crankshaft sensor issue returned on top of that the car began misfiring which was not happening before the repair i brought the vehicle back to the dealership what followed was nearly a monthlong process with very little communication and a lot of mixed information i had to keep reaching out just to get basic updates eventually i was told the car was finally ready the same day i picked it up i noticed a strong smoke smell while driving i immediately contacted the service manager and was told it was likely oil residue burning off from the repair and that it was normal later that same day after driving again the check engine light came on and began blinking i opened the hood and saw visible smoke in the engine bay i had the car scanned and it showed p0300 randommultiple cylinder misfire p0301 cylinder 1 misfire p0303 cylinder 3 misfire p0305 cylinder 5 misfire p0307 cylinder 7 misfire these are essentially the same misfire issues that existed before the most recent repair the blinking cel is especially concerning since that indicates an active misfire and potential catalytic converter damage to add to the frustration before all of this i had previously brought the car in for electrical work and when i got it back from that visit my center display screen stopped working ive mentioned this multiple times but it still hasnt been resolved i also noticed damage to my gear shifter that wasnt there before at this point the car feels unsafe to drive ive been without reliable transportation for weeks the vehicle has come back with more issues than it originally went in with i do have an open case with hyundai corporate but i wanted to post this here both to document the experience and to ask has anyone dealt with repeated failed dealer repairs like this did corporate actually help is there anything specific i should push for when the same codes return after repair i really like this car which makes this whole situation even more frustrating im not trying to bash the brand i just want the vehicle fixed correctly and safely thanks to anyone who took the time to read this

62k repair bill looking for some outside perspective on a tough situation i purchased a 2016 porsche cayenne gts from eskridge lexus of okc in may 2025 which came with a 3 month 3000 mile catastrophic failure warranty at the time of purchase both the salesman and finance manager shared stories about how they had helped past customers in similar situations if something serious happened shortly after purchase which gave me some peace of mind unfortunately within the first 1000 miles the vehicle began throwing a p0017 camshaft timing correlation code because the car was still driveable and the issue wasnt deemed catastrophic i was unable to utilize the warranty over the next several months i spent roughly 3000 attempting to properly diagnose and fix the issue an asecertified vag mechanic inspected the car replaced a vvt component confirmed the engine remained in timing per scan data but the code persisted intermittently performance would fluctuate sometimes driving perfectly other times rough he eventually suspected an electrical or wiringrelated issue wanting a second opinion i brought the car to eurofed south austin where they diagnosed a camshaft position sensor and replaced it the code returned immediately eurofed then suggested the car needed a 10k timing job despite the engine still showing intime and the issue remaining intermittent at this point i was already heavily invested financially and continued researching the issue based on additional investigation i replaced the vvt solenoids which noticeably improved the car smooth idle strong power no immediate codes unfortunately about one hour into a highway drive home for the holidays the engine suffered a catastrophic failure consistent with timingoiling failure the vehicle was towed to porsche south austin who quoted 62000 for a replacement engine and offered 15000 for the vehicle asis for context the car currently retails on carfax around 25000 given the spec and condition prior to failure it could realistically sell 33k35k private party if running ive only owned it 67 months and put approximately 6000 miles on it most of which were driven while actively trying to diagnose and repair an issue that began almost immediately after purchase im considering reaching back out to the selling dealer to ask if theyre willing to offer any goodwill assistance given the early onset of the issue documented repair attempts and short ownership window if thats not possible ill likely sell the vehicle asis im not here to bash anyone just genuinely looking for advice has anyone had success with goodwill assistance in a similar situation is there anything i should approach differently before selling the car asis any perspective from dealers attorneys or porsche owners whove been through something similar appreciate any constructive input

i went to hell for not returning my shopping cart 4300 words chapter 1 time doesnt pass in this place it accumulates i dont know how long i was confined to the parking lot a thousand years maybe even a million i eventually learned the secret language of shopping carts i understood the unique wobble of every rusted wheel i can easily recognize the specific shriek of a misaligned frame i knew them better than i had ever known my own self im mad to admit how i got here i shouldnt have carelessly left that shopping cart in that open parking spot but i am in hell and rounding up shopping carts is my punishment my punishment is brutally simple and entirely eternal i was tasked with gathering carts from an endless lot that stretched toward a shimmering horizon of heat my job was to connect them into long trains then push them into the corrals i would nest them perfectly until they formed an orderly monument to my own meticulous diligence then the wind would inevitably come it was never a natural breeze but always a personal insult to my work a targeted supernatural gust that would tear through the lot with malicious intent it would lift my perfectly gathered carts and scatter them like spilled coins across the pavement they would roll into drainage ditches get wedged between curbs and up onto sidewalks theyd careen into the pristine sides of classic cars i couldnt physically touch and then i would simply start again i performed this mindless task until the words shopping cart lost all meaning i continued until my own name felt like it belonged to someone else i was no longer gary the man who died from a gas station taquito instead i was a mindless automaton whose only purpose was to push pull and gather my hope was a fossilized husk and my anger had been slowly scoured away by the sandpaper of repetition my punishment has turned my original feelings of defeat into a smooth hard core of pure unadulterated resentment today i was pushing a train of about fifty carts when a particularly strong gust of wind struck the convoy the cart at the very front suddenly broke free from the train it did not simply roll but rocketed across the asphalt at dangerous speeds it slammed head first into the drivers side door of a pristine 1970s lincoln continental the sharp crunch of metal echoed across the silent lot it was a violent sound all i could do was sigh in irritation something inside me stirred that hard and smooth core of resentment finally fractured under the pressure i immediately released the handle of the remaining train and did not even bother to watch as the rest of the carts scattered across the pavement i simply did not care anymore i turned my back on the entire scene and started walking as i walked away from the lot a small bricked building lined with windows shimmered into existence directly ahead of me the beige waiting room from my initial arrival peering at me through the windows everything appearing like a mirage of purgatorial bureaucracy i pushed through the door of the building and marched straight up to the counter where barry my demon probational worker was standing he wasnt technically my enlisted policing authority he was however the first and only humanlike entity ive had to deal with he processed me into hell and lead me to my assignment in the very beginning i remember having to grab a ticket and sit in his small beige waiting room occupied by no one besides me and wait several hundreds of years to be called is there a problem with your designated station he mumbled while misting a single sad looking leaf not even looking up i need to speak with a manager right now i said my voice filled with desperation and anger barry finally looked at me his dull gray eyes widening with genuine surprise a manager sir the system is the system the cart gathering assignment is a level three damnation which is completely nonnegotiable i honestly do not care about the carts anymore i said leaning my entire body over the counter i want to file a formal complaint about the wind it is aggressive and it feels personal i am certain that this kind of treatment is against some type of union regulation down here barry could only stare at me his mouth hanging slightly agape he had processed the screams of the damned for an eternity to come but a formal complaint about the weather was more than likely something entirely new to him i do not believe we actually have a form for that particular issue he stammered then get me someone who is responsible for creating the forms i demanded with sudden force right now he blinked once and then slowly and deliberately picked up the telephone and pressed a single button he spoke into the receiver in a hushed reverent tone after a moment he hung up the phone and looked back at me there was a flicker of something that might have been genuine fear visible in his eyes he will see you now a door behind the counter swung open revealing a long hallway that smelled faintly of burnt coffee and profound regret i did not hesitate for even a second it was finally time for me to demand my performance review chapter two the deeper i walked down the hallway the more closed in i felt it was long and gray it had low ceilings that made the space feel oppressive as if the building itself was stressed from being in hell the door at the end was black with a single polished brass handle that felt cold to the touch i figured that if since i survived an eternity of shopping carts then a bureaucratic meeting could not be worse i pushed the door open and stepped into an office it was not the throne of fire and shadow i had expected it was no simpler than a corner office a large mahogany desk sat in front of a panoramic window that did not look out upon lakes of fire but upon a sea of clouds under a blood red sky the walls were lined with binders labeled things like q4 torment projections and union negotiations pitchfork local 666 behind the desk was a man in an impeccably tailored suit rubbing his temples the nameplate on the desk said l satan ceo he was on the phone his voice choppy with the kind of irritation only a person dealing with terrible customer service can create no i understand the extended warranty is very comprehensive but im telling you the toaster is damned its a flaw not a feature yes ill hold he slammed the phone down the crack echoing in the quiet office he glared at me what i stood my ground my punishment the shopping carts its not a suitable fit he raised an eyebrow a flicker of amusement crossed his face not a suitable fit gary you left a cart in a handicapped spot the paperwork alone caused a demonic clerk to take a three day stress leave its a perfect fit the wind is personal i said the words feeling foolish as soon as they left my mouth and its repetitive there is no room for growth if im expected to learn something here satan leaned back in his chair a predatory smile spreading across his face growth i see he steepled his fingers youre not a screamer i like that the screamers are so dreadfully predictable but you youre an interesting kind of sinner youre the mundane kind you think your sin was small so your punishment should be small you dont understand hell isnt about the magnitude of the sin gary its about the theme your theme is carelessness a small and insidious carelessness that frays the edges of civilization he snapped his fingers a shimmering document appeared on his desk so im going to offer you a deal a chance at a lateral transfer lets call it the gauntlet of minor annoyances you need to successfully navigate nine circles of my personal hell each one themed around a different brand of carelessness beat them all and ill find you a more specialized position something with a little more variety fail and you get a thousand years in the replyall mines do we have a deal gary i looked at the document then at his smiling face a thousand years of replyall emails i would take the these circles deal i said excellent satan said clapping his hands together lets begin with the fundamentals shall we the office dissolved the mahogany desk and the view of the clouds vanished everything replaced by the cold echoing space of a massive underground chamber before me was an escalator it descended into a deeper darkness its metal steps endlessly disappearing down into the darkness the escalator being swallowed into it i dont get it look satan said sighing i could feel him getting irritated with me its not your culture but it is for others you do not block the left side of an escalator i didnt respond it didnt matter i need to get through these circles i took a deep breath and stepped towards the escalator excuse me i said politely to the first person time i was met with a vacant stare or an annoyed sigh it was as if i were the one being unreasonable i weaved and bobbed a fish swimming upstream against a current of pure apathy the climb down felt like it took years my frustration built a hot knot in my stomach started to form i wanted to scream i wanted to shove them all off into the the abyss but then i remembered the wind the endless pointless infuriating wind this was no different it was just another kind of obstacle my anger cooled i stopped fighting it i became a patient shadow i began to slip through the cracks of their inattention finally after what felt like an age i reached the bottom step and stepped onto solid ground the world shimmered and faded i was standing once again in the beige waiting room the sign above the counter changed from please wait to circle one complete barry looked up from his ficus plant and gave me a single nod it felt like respect i had passed the first test eight more circles of hell to go chapter three the beige of the waiting room faded and was replaced by the cold scent of concrete and dust i was standing in the middle of a multi level parking garage that stretched upward and downward into an impenetrable gloom the low hum of fluorescent lights overhead was the only sound row after row of cars stretched out before me they were a monument to poor decisions circle two satans voice echoed through the cavernous space the parking lot of spatial entropy your task is simple gary find one legal parking spot then park in it before i raised a question about how i could park a car forward operating base family the proposed armored vehicle family consists of highly modular platforms that establish an additional tier beyond current main battle tanks with maximum versatility as the primary objective weights range from approximately 50 tonsmatching or upgrading existing mbts such as the m1 abramsto 6580 tons for enhanced variants modularity enables variants tailored to specific roles threats environments us military branches and export markets not every platform incorporates all extreme features some variants are amphibious some include internal bays for carrying and deploying smaller vehicles apcs troops or bridging systems some serve as semistatic forward operating bases with heavy firepower while others remain standardweight modified tanks compatible with existing roads bridges and logistics roadcapable variants are engineered to remain sufficiently light and narrow for standard use road restrictions in other variants often result from increased width caused by carrier design for internal volume andor amphibious requirements for buoyancy and stability rather than weight alone many configurations remain roadcompatible particularly those not intended to transport fullsized tanks such as troopapconly carriers or noncarrier designs road limitations typically arise as a byproduct of other design prioritiesprotection firepower amphibious capability or internal capacityrather than deliberate intent to exceed limits highend variants provide maximum armor protection against drones ieds mines and artillery multigun and artillery capabilities amphibious options internal bays for secure transport and deployment and a role as a protected anchor after sealift or limited airlift to suitable terrain the platform functions as a groundbased equivalent to close air support analogous to the a10 thunderbolt ii or ac130 gunship without the airborne component delivering sustained firepower and protection modularity supports adaptation across us branches army for heavy tracked marine corpsnavy for amphibiouslittoral air force for airlift and base defense tradeoffs in weight mobility transportability and vulnerability to precision threats are accepted no military program currently develops superheavy internalcarrier platforms at this scale the concept remains theoretical closest existing parallels are modular programs in the 5080 ton range including the m1e3 abrams xm30 mechanized infantry combat vehicle k2 black panther and acv family this family includes superheavyweight and massive variants in some cases heavily armored with maximum firepower multiple guns and antidrone antiied and landmine capabilities serving as the ultimate heavy slow longrange tank that can also incorporate artillery certain variants are amphibious and can carry other tanks apcs and marines inside safely and relatively comfortably in configurations too heavy or too wide for roadsoften due to the carrier aspect or amphibious designthe internal assets can drive on roads and deploy land bridge tanks the platform operates as a rolling ac130 or a10 equivalent roadrestricted variants require ships and large aircraft for longdistance transport and deployment onto open terrain once in position the platform anchors as a mobile and immobile forward operating base while internal lighter vehicles handle roads rivers cities and maneuver operations it is not a single allinone design nor even a distinct class but multiple classes above current ones the platforms are modifiable with many different kinds and configurations for different purposes roles possibilities enemies environments military branches and countries with the united states as the primary developer in mind not every variant must include all features tradeoffs and practical realities are to be considered and weighed and the entire family prioritizes versatility above all else not all variants need to be amphibious carriers or superheavythat is why some can be only 50 tons the same us takes a step toward approving seabed mining in international waters the trump administration said on tuesday that it had received an application for seabed mining exploration in international waters the first in its effort to encourage the controversial industry the federal government said it was formally considering the first permit applications from the metals company which has become a forerunner in the race to mine the deep ocean for precious minerals the company has said publicly that it hopes to start commercial mining operations in the pacific ocean in 2027 parts of the ocean floor are covered with fistsize nodules that contain nickel cobalt manganese and copper for decades a united nations organization the international seabed authority has been trying to negotiate rules to regulate mining in international waters the united states isnt a member of that effort president trump has made seabed mining a priority in april he signed an executive order calling for permits in both us and international waters and a week later the metals company filed its applications along with tuesdays notice the national oceanic and atmospheric administration posted the mining applications for public comment and scheduled public hearings for late january noaa is working to ensure that the review of the applications goes forward without undue delays according to alison gillespie a spokeswoman for the agency the depths of the ocean have never been commercially mined and overcoming the technological hurdles to doing so is costly the minerals found there are used in cleanenergy technologies such as batteries for electric vehicles but the trump administration has emphasized their importance for national security the metals companys proposal to begin mining by 2027 is ambitious said lori osmundsen an environmental lawyer who specializes in ocean law although pressure from the trump administration along with noaas efforts to streamline the process means that this speedy timeline isnt impossible broad opposition to seabed mining makes it likely that the company will face court challenges that may set it back further complicating matters the us permit process essentially sidesteps the international seabed authority which under a 1994 international agreement known as the law of the sea regulates mineral extraction from the seafloor the seabed authority hasnt yet approved activity beyond exploring potential mining zones the united states hasnt ratified the law of the sea the metals company based in canada already holds active exploration permits through the un authority sponsored by countries that have agreed to follow its rules in 2022 under these permits the company conducted a mining test in the clarionclipperton zone a region of the pacific ocean between hawaii and mexico the areas outlined in the companys us mining application overlap substantially with its existing ones in june the company updated its agreement with naru one of its sponsor countries to allow for the conflicting permits if the united states approves the companys applications this jurisdictional tangle will put it on untested legal ground ms osmundsen said its a complete gray area she said adding that the fallout could result in international conflict or litigation the prospect of mining the deep ocean has prompted worldwide environmental concern nearly 40 countries have called for a moratorium or ban on seabed mining including germany france and new zealand polynesian leadership in american samoa has maintained a moratorium against mining despite the trump administrations recent push to expand the industrys access to its waters in august 130 scientists signed a letter opposing mining saying that not enough is known about the biodiversityrich habitats at the depths of the ocean if the metals companys application process with the united states moves forward it will be required to submit an environmentalimpact statement in anticipation of that step the company has spent years and millions of dollars funding research some of the studies it has funded have been independently published in peerreviewed journals and detail the damage mining could cause the seafloor ecosystem michael clarke the companys environmental manager said the data for the environmental report was ready to go and that the company was waiting to format it for regulators the application outlines some of these findings addressing issues of particular concern to environmentalists such as the spread of sediment plumes from mining and the effects on commercial fisheries and animals on the seafloor there are economic questions as well the market demand for the metals found in the seabed may not grow as strongly as some have predicted said lyle trytten an independent mining consultant for copper and nickel companies mr trytten recently cowrote an analysis for the national ocean protection coalition a partnership of environmental organizations it found commercial success was highly unlikely within the next 15 years in part because demand for the metals would be outpaced by current supply it really hinges a lot on future trends in electricvehicle and gridstorage batteries he said china for example is a leader in renewable energy technologies but has stepped away from using cobalt and nickel in its batteries and the worlds main cobalt producer the democratic republic of congo has imposed export restrictions in response to a market glut and falling prices

the united nations development program biodiversity financing initiative undp biofin held its annual seminar in beijing with nio as the only invited automobile manufacturer in the immediate term this certainly does not generate more sales nor is it a catalyst to boost the price the annual undp biodiversity financing initiative biofin seminar in beijing is not a commercial event that nio was the only invited car manufacturer does not point to sales but to institutional legitimacy not even an et5 is going to be sold there but who gets to sit at the table is decided when the rules are written biofin does not talk to startups it talks to ministries regulators development banks multilateral agencies being there means aligning yourself with the state agenda not with the retail consumer approvals permits standards in the coming years all of this is not defined in the showroom it is defined in these forums being present early reduces future friction environmental traceability carbon footprint circular economy battery lifecycle that they invite nioand not byd not tesla not saicsuggests something very concrete nio is not being read just as automotive but as a technologicalenergyenvironmental actor ok this is the full text for anyone who wants to read it taken from a chinese website from december 20 to 21 2025 the united nations development program biodiversity financing initiative undp biofin held its annual seminar in beijing with nio as the only invited automobile manufacturer the seminar brought together leaders experts and academics from governments research institutions companies and social organizations qin lihong cofounder and president of nio delivered a keynote speech titled nios systematic practices in the field of dual carbon and biodiversity and participated in a panel discussion qin lihong explained that nios mission is advancing towards a blue sky and that it never considers climate and biodiversity as an additional responsibility nio has been exploring and practicing ways to reduce its environmental impact and make a positive impact in realworld situations building on its own technological background and operational methods qin lihong systematically introduced nios exploration and practice achievements to the attendees from seven aspects i clean parks project initiated by nio in 2021 the qinglang national park clean parks ecological coconstruction project has partnered with the united nations development program undp and the world wildlife fund wwf to establish 18 projects globally continuously exploring clean energy integration and ecological protection among them the shanghai chongming dongtan national nature bird reserve project for example has created a selfcirculating energy replenishment system to obtain clean and lowcarbon energy in the protected area ii new energy and renewable practices in vehicle body materials nio is committed to collaborating with its partners to explore a series of green materials clean materials which include renewable recyclable and userfriendly materials with lower carbon emissions for example the ecofriendly clean fabric used in the et5 model is made from 100 pet reducing environmental pollution the clean polymer material used in the et5 model combines natural minerals and plant fibers reducing carbon emissions in the production process by more than 30 compared to conventional materials iii sustainable development achievements of nio advanced manufacturing plant since 2017 nio has been exploring the use of geothermal heat pumps to maintain a constant temperature in its factories while making the most of photovoltaics and green electricity currently renewable energy accounts for more than 50 of the total electricity consumption at nios hefei no 1 advanced manufacturing plant and xinqiao no 2 advanced manufacturing plant nios xinqiao no 2 advanced manufacturing plant adopted the sponge city concept during the design phase employing various technological measures to fully develop rainwater harvesting systems achieve sustainable water recycling and prevent flooding during the rainy season iv carbon reduction practices in supply chain management in terms of supply chain management nios advanced manufacturing plant is located in anhui province supported by the auto parts sector in the middle and lower reaches of the yangtze river in china this allows 90 of the materials necessary for production to be transported over a oneway distance of 500 kilometers thus achieving energy savings and reducing emissions nio has also pioneered a vehicletovehicle recycling system v environmental protection practices in energy services as of november 2025 nio had built 3662 battery swapping stations globally completing the design of its highway battery swapping network of 9 vertical 11 horizontal and 16 large urban clusters in china nio holds more than 1000 patents related to vehicle battery swapping and has participated in the formulation of relevant standards nationwide more than 2300 nio battery swapping stations participate in the state grids peak shaving charging program and 655 nio battery swapping stations and 27000 charging stacks participate in the program through its participation in the peak shaving program nio has saved a total of 34 million kilowatthours of electricity in 14 provinces and cities vi nio life promotes ecological fashion in 2021 nio founded blue sky lab using leftover automotivegrade materials such as airbags seat belts and haptex basf leather from automobile manufacturing as core materials to create a fashion series exploring how to upgrade from recycle to upcycle vii promote the popularization of carbon trading concepts in addition qin lihong called for the development of relevant industrial standards at the seminar the undp china offices biodiversity financing project biofin annual seminar focused on indepth discussions on global sustainable development issues such as climate and biodiversity conservation and carbon reduction targets nio case studies received great attention and recognition from participants attendees expressed hope that nio could refine them into replicable and scalable models

family lost everything to a fire in the early morning hours of december 21st around 330 am my aunt and uncle les and sue lost everything they have worked so tirelessly to build the cause of the fire is currently unknown but if their son had not happened to be awake and stepped outsidehearing crackling coming from their workshopthis tragedy could have taken all 4 of their lives thanks to his quick actions they were able to escape with nothing but the clothes on their backs their dogs and their vehicle although we are so thankful les sue dakota and ryan are alive they had poured their lifetime savings time and love into creating an allinclusive campsite in the ozarks of arkansasa place meant for friends families and anyone wanting to experience the beauty of the area they sold their home and most of their belongings to purchase the land clear it bring utilities to the property and handbuild a space they could proudly and comfortably call home in the fire they lost their rv workshop tiny home all of their personal belongings and their beloved cat jennyall deemed total losses to make matters worse insurance will not cover a large part of the damage because electricity was scheduled to be installed next week a requirement for insurance coverage this devastating loss is taking an unimaginable physical financial and emotional toll especially with the holidays just days away this has left them and their 2 sons homeless for the unforeseen future les and sue are the kind of people who would give you the shirt off their backs even if it was all they had they have so before any helpwhether through a donation or simply sharing this pagewould mean more than words can express thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your kindness and support proceeds will go towards clearing their losses rebuilding their home replacing their personal belongings and paying back loans for building materialsstructures lost in the fire
